✨ deep-eye | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated, AI-enhanced penetration testing and vulnerability scanning with intelligent payload generation and professional reporting.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-AI Provider Support (11 providers with failover) • 50+ Vulnerability Checks (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, JWT deep, IDOR, GraphQL deep, CORS/CSP, supply-chain JS, etc.) • OpenAPI Ingest for seeding crawls • Context-Aware Payloads (WAF fingerprint, tech stack, CVE-aware generation) • CVE Intelligence (RAG-indexed CVE DB)
📖 Summary: Deep Eye is an advanced AI-driven penetration testing tool that orchestrates multiple AI providers for intelligent payload generation. It scans targets for over 50 vulnerability types and generates professional reports with compliance mapping, deduplication, and retest workflows.
